required_inputs: A0 strict recursive inventory and exact formal-probe authority supplement
released S0.1 correction packet and independent review roots

layering.ledger: immutable semantics only; no empirical corpus statistics
layering.validation_receipt: adversarial static fixtures and source/formula/clip/mask checks
layering.empirical_audit: later Stage B consumes only sealed and independently reviewed corrected train corpus

source_state_contract.available: source exists and the atom formula is evaluated
source_state_contract.not_applicable: source is validly absent by scene semantics and the ledger explicitly authorizes a zero
source_state_contract.unavailable: required causal source is absent; source mask is false and selection/training eligibility follows the row policy
source_state_contract.invalid: source exists but violates schema, mapping, finite, or invariant checks; fail closed

ordered_schema_formula_hash.canonicalization: UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted object keys and preserved atom-row array order

canonical_semantic_block_hash.deduplication: deduplicate exact semantic-parameter hashes before block weighting; route, seed, and tick remain nested repeated measures

requirements: name, formula, schema, and monotonicity must agree
all-K missing reference must fail closed without candidate0 or all-K fallback
both options receive adversarial mixed source-valid/physical-feasible fixtures

future_v2i_gate: wrong-id, phase-mismatch, replay, future, and stale fail-closed tests

candidate0_contract.meaning: fixed DP operational-default alias from the same forward

training_scale_estimator_plan.block_weighting: equal total mass per source-independent semantic block, then equal route, seed, tick, and eligible-candidate mass within each parent
training_scale_estimator_plan.positive_support_rule: strictly positive finite raw values among source-valid applicable candidate rows only
training_scale_estimator_plan.zero_support_rule: no continuous estimate; mark support-limited and block silent substitution or removal
training_scale_estimator_plan.red_binary_alternative: report 1(raw_atom>0) with scale 1.0 beside the continuous definition; no automatic replacement

required_before_selection: record Theta, phi, and w hashes

stage_dag: A0 strict inventory, exact formal probe authority, and simplex hardening
A static atom ledger and independent validation
B sealed train-only empirical audit and training-scale freeze
C seven-family outcome-blind single-axis perturbation audit
Q Fresh B2 pre-open qualification and power

stage_gate_contracts.A_exit: 14 rows complete, source/formula/clip/mask checks pass, independent numeric recompute passes, and progress choice is packaged for Ultra
stage_gate_contracts.R_entry: separate Ultra release binding S0.1, A0, ledger, validation, progress decision, fixed DP, formal source, and corrected HEAD
stage_gate_contracts.C_entry: B PASS and separate Ultra release
stage_gate_contracts.C_exit: seven-family PASS/WARN/FAIL plus remediation class, with no outcome-selected parameters
stage_gate_contracts.D_entry: B PASS and separate Ultra release
stage_gate_contracts.D_exit: focused algebra/source findings plus combined independent review
stage_gate_contracts.E1_entry: C and D combined review PASS plus Ultra release
